Aji {{tag}}, built from {{commit}}.

Download the installer for your system below. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists each file's SHA-256.

The installers are not signed yet, so the system asks once before Aji first opens:

- **Windows:** SmartScreen says it protected your PC. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** macOS says it cannot check Aji for malicious software. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to Security, and click "Open Anyway" next to Aji.
- **Linux:** the AppImage is built but has not been tested on real hardware.

What was checked before this release: [docs/acceptance/phase-1.md](https://github.com/reallxuan/Aji/blob/main/docs/acceptance/phase-1.md).
